title: The Physical Cutoff Does Not Restore Homogenization: Phase-Dependent Burning in the Strain G-Equation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We disprove the expectation stated by Xin, Yu, and Ronney that the physical positive part strain $G$-equation should possess an effective burning velocity in cellular flows. For the standard cellular flow in dimension two $V_A(x_1,x_2)=A(-\sin x_1\cos x_2,\cos x_1\sin x_2)$, if $0<20/399$ and $\sqrt{1+4d^2}0$ universal. The same conclusions hold for arbitrary continuous periodic perturbations of planar initial data. Under the physical scaling $V_A(x/\varepsilon)$ and $d_\varepsilon=\varepsilon d$, an order one value gap persists between points at distance $O(\varepsilon)$ at every positive macroscopic time, so the rescaled solutions have no locally uniformly convergent subsequence. The proof uses the Hamiltonian sandwich $H_{\mathrm{unc}}\le H_+\le\widehat H$. translated_title: 物理截断并未恢复均匀化：应变G方程中的相位依赖燃烧
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15337v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们否证了Xin、Yu和Ronney所预期的物理正部分应变G方程在细胞流中应具有有效燃烧速度的期望。对于二维标准细胞流$V_A(x_1,x_2)=A(-\sin x_1\cos x_2,\cos x_1\sin x_2)$，若$0<20/399$且$\sqrt{1+4d^2}<A$，则对任意初始数据，该方程的解在时间$t\to\infty$时表现出相位依赖的燃烧行为，其中燃烧速度随初始相位的变化而不同，且该差异对任意$d>0$具有普遍性。同样的结论适用于平面初始数据的任意连续周期扰动。在物理尺度$V_A(x/\varepsilon)$和$d_\varepsilon=\varepsilon d$下，在任意正宏观时间，距离为$O(\varepsilon)$的点之间仍存在数量级为一的值差，因此重标度后的解不存在局部一致收敛的子序列。证明使用了哈密顿夹层$H_{\mathrm{unc}}\le H_+\le\widehat H$。上比较器$\widehat H$是一个矩形支撑函数，等价于状态依赖信度集上的上期望，其反向控制动力学具有...
tldr: 本文否证了物理截断应变G方程在细胞流中的均匀化预期，揭示了相位依赖燃烧现象，并证明重标度解不存在局部一致收敛子序列。
en_tdlr: This paper disproves the homogenization expectation for the physical cutoff strain G-equation in cellular flows, revealing phase-dependent burning and showing that rescaled solutions lack locally uniformly convergent subsequences.
